en.title: Imagine {brand} in her day.
en.text: She opens Book. Makeup, hair, skincare, nails, henna, spa and more. Her next beauty moment starts here.

ar.title: {brand} جزء من يومها.
ar.text: تفتح قسم الحجز: مكياج وشعر وبشرة وأظافر وحنّاء وسبا والمزيد. هنا تبدأ رحلة الجمال.

chapters.purpose: Introduce the breadth of the booking app. A client discovers the available service categories before selecting one.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show the Book screen; keep the optional name/salon personalisation disclosure. Next chapter opens service selection.

en.title: First, the look she has in mind.
en.text: Soft glam, evening glam, bridal makeup or a lesson. She finds the service that fits her occasion.

ar.title: البداية بإطلالة في البال.
ar.text: مكياج ناعم أو مسائي أو عروس أو درس تجميل. تختار الخدمة التي تناسب مناسبتها.

chapters.purpose: Explain choosing the actual service, not only a beauty category.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show the makeup-service list. Describe service choice without promising the example prices or durations.

en.title: Beauty, wherever she wants it.
en.text: At home, the artist comes to her. At the venue, she visits the beauty space. The choice follows the locations offered for the service.

ar.title: الجمال، حيث يناسبها.
ar.text: في المنزل تصل الخبيرة إليها. وفي المكان تزور مساحة التجميل. تختار من المواقع المتاحة للخدمة.

chapters.purpose: Explain the user-approved home AND venue model. Availability depends on the selected service.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show both location photo cards. Never replace this chapter with home-only wording or assume venue means event sponsorship.

en.title: She finds an artist who fits.
en.text: She can narrow her search by location, price, rating and availability. This is where {brand} becomes part of her shortlist.

ar.title: تجد الخبيرة المناسبة.
ar.text: تبحث حسب الموقع والسعر والتقييم والتوفر. وهنا يظهر {brand} ضمن خياراتها.

chapters.purpose: Explain how a client narrows down artists.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show the filter sheet. Mention location, price, rating and availability, without treating sample counts as live inventory.

en.title: Your work tells your story.
en.text: She explores the portfolio, services and reviews. Even the makeup kit has a place, so she can get to know the details behind the look.

ar.title: الأعمال تحكي القصة.
ar.text: تتصفّح الأعمال والخدمات والتقييمات. وحتى حقيبة المكياج لها مساحة للتعرّف إلى تفاصيل الإطلالة.

chapters.purpose: Explain how the client evaluates an artist’s work before booking.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show the portfolio tab. Preserve the two extra-screen links for makeup kit and profile reviews.

en.title: A day. A time. A plan.
en.text: She chooses an available appointment and reviews the service, location and time before continuing with her booking.

ar.title: يوم. ووقت. وخطة.
ar.text: تختار موعدًا متاحًا وتراجع الخدمة والموقع والوقت قبل متابعة الحجز.

chapters.purpose: Explain selecting an available appointment after choosing service, location and artist.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show day/time selection. Do not call this a confirmed booking: the screen says Continue. Next chapter explicitly switches to the partner perspective.

en.title: Behind every look, your business.
en.text: Switch to the artist’s side. {brand} has a place to manage active services, drafts and availability.

ar.title: وراء كل إطلالة، مشروع.
ar.text: ننتقل إلى جهة الخبيرة. لدى {brand} مساحة لإدارة الخدمات النشطة والمسودات والتوفر.

chapters.purpose: Introduce the partner’s management side of the same app.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show My services with active/draft services and availability entry point. Preserve the second hero shortcut to this chapter.

en.title: You shape the service.
en.text: Set the description, price, duration and locations. Add tools, brands and previous work so the service reflects your craft.

ar.title: الخدمة بتفاصيلها الخاصة.
ar.text: تحديد الوصف والسعر والمدة والمواقع. وإضافة الأدوات والعلامات والأعمال السابقة ليعكس الملف المهارة.

chapters.purpose: Explain what the partner configures for a service.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show name, description, price, duration, home/venue locations, tools, photos and active status. Describe screen controls; do not turn the image into fake working inputs.

en.title: Your schedule has a say.
en.text: Working hours, time between appointments and blocked dates. Shape availability around the way you work, at home and at the venue.

ar.title: المواعيد وفق جدول العمل.
ar.text: ساعات العمل والفواصل بين المواعيد والأيام غير المتاحة. تنظيم التوفر للخدمات المنزلية وفي المكان.

chapters.purpose: Explain availability management rather than guaranteed booking availability.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show hours, days off, appointment buffers and blocked dates. Keep both locations in the explanation.

en.title: The details, before you say yes.
en.text: See the client, service, date, location and notes. Message her, suggest another time, or accept or decline the request.

ar.title: كل التفاصيل قبل القبول.
ar.text: عرض العميلة والخدمة والتاريخ والموقع والملاحظات. يمكن مراسلتها أو اقتراح وقت آخر أو قبول الطلب أو رفضه.

chapters.purpose: Explain the decision point after a request arrives.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show client, service, time, address and notes. Include message, propose-time, accept and decline possibilities. Do not imply that every request is automatically accepted.

en.title: A clear view of what’s next.
en.text: Confirmed appointments come together in the reservations timeline. Service, client and timing, all in the context of your day.

ar.title: صورة واضحة للمواعيد القادمة.
ar.text: تجتمع المواعيد المؤكدة في جدول الحجوزات، مع الخدمة والعميلة والوقت ضمن يوم العمل.

chapters.purpose: Explain how confirmed appointments fit into a partner’s day.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show the reservations timeline. Treat the displayed month, clients, appointment times and statuses as examples.

en.title: A reputation that grows with you.
en.text: Reviews carry the experience forward. View client feedback, and share your own review after the appointment. The next chapter starts with {brand}.

ar.title: سمعة تنمو مع كل تجربة.
ar.text: التقييمات تواصل حكاية التجربة. الاطلاع على آراء العميلات ومشاركة تقييم بعد الموعد. والفصل القادم يبدأ مع {brand}.

chapters.purpose: Explain reputation and feedback after the appointment, in both directions.
chapters.page_behavior_to_preserve: Show the partner review overview; preserve the artist-reviews-client extra screen and the beauty-partner application CTA.

known_limits: Screenshots are illustrative and their controls are not interactive on this website.
Original raster screenshots remain English when the surrounding website is Arabic.
The shared applicationEndpoint and deck URLs are null; no application is sent in the current preview configuration.
Shared form.js still hardcodes beauty payload where to app-home; this is an unresolved schema mismatch with the newly confirmed home/venue model.
The shared form service choices are narrower than the service categories pictured in the Book screenshot.
tools/build_pages.py overwrites beauty.html from older partials and journey data that do not contain this implementation.
